title: RunConfig
description: Configuration for one Run of GSM Sourcer.

kind.description: Opaque to engine; meaningful to a DiscoveryKS that recognizes it (e.g. 'git-repo', 'local-path', 'openapi-doc').

uri.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URI of a Sourcing Pack. No implicit 'latest'.

axis1.description: Intake filter profile (Axis-1, depth). Applied as a Control admission policy at SubjectIdentity creation time.

axis2.description: Granularity / consolidation profile (Axis-2). Biases which GranularityKSs are eligible to fire.

targetCatalogues.description: Catalogue archetype roots a contributor may attach (e.g. TOGAF, SAFe, ISO 25000). Restricts which ArchetypingKS contributions are eligible.

contributionResolvers.description: Per-panel ContributionResolver selection. Default per panel: SourceInterpretation = collectAll; SubjectIdentity = highestConfidence; Archetyping = collectAll (the resolved value is the union of accepted contributions); Statement = highestConfidence; Granularity = highestConfidence; Evidence = collectAll; Confidence = highestConfidence.

checkpointA.description: Pause after Blackboard convergence, before Validation pipeline stage.

checkpointB.description: Pause after Validation, before Registration pipeline stage.

convergence.description: Stopping criteria for the Blackboard convergence loop.

quiesceAfterEmptyIterations.description: Number of consecutive iterations with zero new Contributions before declaring quiescence.

Resolver.description: ContributionResolver. `collectAll` = effective value is union/concat of all contributions (used for additive panels). `userMediated` = escalate to a Checkpoint if more than one contribution exists.
